title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting

translated_title: 稀疏贝叶斯学习的谱不确定性分解
translated_abstract: 从脑磁图/脑电图（M/EEG）测量中估计分布式神经源是一个病态逆问题，其中基于原理的不确定性量化仍然具有挑战性。通常的条件高斯后验协方差并未明确区分沿似然可见源方向的不确定性与测量不可见的不确定性。我们提出了一个基于先验预条件前向算子奇异值结构的谱框架，该框架将后验协方差精确且可解释地分解为数据知情成分与不可确定性认知成分。这一公式化方法能够识别哪些不确定性贡献可以通过更好的测量加以减少，哪些是由传感几何结构决定的根本不可减少的不确定性。我们进一步推导出一个等价的减法分解，将先验协方差表示为后验项与数据驱动减少项之和，从而实现精确核算
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于先验预条件前向算子奇异值结构的谱框架，将稀疏贝叶斯学习中的后验协方差精确分解为可通过改进测量而减少的数据知情成分与由传感几何决定的不可约不确定性成分。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which exactly decomposes the posterior covariance in sparse Bayesian learning into data-informed components reducible by better measurements and fundamentally irreducible indeterminacy determined by sensing geometry.
